description: The elapsed-date escape hatch only fires when the named year belongs to the LATER edition. Here the post names the PAST edition's year (2026) alongside elapsed dates, so the hatch must NOT rescue the extraction: the post still recounts the 2026 edition's window and sets nothing for 2027.

posts.text: In 2026 our dealer applications opened January 5th and closed February 1st — thank you to every vendor who applied. Details for next year are coming soon!

_comment: "In 2026" names the past edition, not a later one, so the year-or-hashtag hatch does not apply; both elapsed dates precede exampcon-2027's previousEditionEnd (2026-02-09).
